title: EventEnvelope
description: One append-only entry in the session log. Every module writes and reads events in this shape. Payload shape is defined per event_type in registry.json.

event_type.description: <namespace>.<name>. The namespace decides which track owns the type (see registry.json).

event_version.description: Version of the payload schema for this event_type.

source.description: Module that emitted the event, e.g. curriculum, socratic_engine, lesson_player.

session_id.description: Learning session this belongs to; null for events outside a session (e.g. profile.selected).

student_id.description: Student profile; null only for household-level events (e.g. parent actions).

payload.description: Shape depends on event_type; validated against the payload schema listed in registry.json.
